reason: The passage describes the Israelite people becoming bitter and threatening to stone David due to their captured families (וַתֵּ֨צֶר לְדָוִ֜ד מְאֹ֗ד כִּֽי־ אָמְר֤וּ הָעָם֙ לְסָקְל֔וֹ), but this represents the people complaining/blaming their leaders, not Hebrew leaders complaining about the people. The text shows David's soldiers expressing distress over their losses, not leaders criticizing the people. No Hebrew leaders in this passage are depicted as complaining about the people.
